fr.finalAnswer:
[La synthèse exécutive (p.2) retient un EBITDA normalisé 2025 de 14,2 M€ appliqué à un multiple de 8,0x, soit une valeur d'entreprise de 113,6 M€](cite:1)[. Le pont de normalisation (section Quality of Earnings, p.5) détaille les retraitements : +0,7 M€ (rémunération dirigeant), +0,6 M€ (honoraires M&A), +2,4 M€ (sous-traitance logistique dite « [ponctuelle](halluc:1) »), −1,6 M€ (cession d'actifs). L'observation des conseils signale que les 2,4 M€ de sous-traitance correspondent à trois contrats pluriannuels reconduits sans interruption sur 2023-2025, donc de nature récurrente](cite:2)[. Retraités correctement, l'EBITDA normalisé ressort à 11,8 M€ et non 14,2 M€](cite:3)[. La base de valorisation de la synthèse (14,2 M€) contredit donc le détail de la section 04. À 11,8 M€, le même multiple de 8,0x donne 94,4 M€, soit un écart de valeur d'entreprise d'environ 19,2 M€. Le chiffre n'est pas fiable tant que le comité n'a pas tranché la qualification du retraitement (p.7). L'annexe C (contrats de sous-traitance logistique) confirme que les trois contrats ont été reconduits sans interruption sur 2023-2025, par tacite reconduction annuelle](cite:4).

L'impact est suffisamment significatif pour changer la recommandation :

| Base | EBITDA normalisé | Multiple | Valeur d'entreprise |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Synthèse exécutive | 14,2 M€ | 8,0x | 113,6 M€ |
| Retraité (conseils) | 11,8 M€ | 8,0x | [94,4 M€](cite:3) |
| **Écart** | **2,4 M€** | - | **19,2 M€** |

Le comité doit confirmer la base retenue avant signature.

Je calcule l'impact : à 11,8 M€ d'EBITDA retraité, la valeur d'entreprise tombe à 94,4 M€ au lieu de 113,6 M€, soit un écart de 19,2 M€. Comparer la base de valorisation retenue dans la synthèse exécutive (14,2 M€) avec le détail du pont de normalisation en section Quality of Earnings (retraitement net de 2,4 M€). Les deux chiffres devraient converger si la méthodologie est appliquée de façon cohérente d'une section à l'autre.

Le retraitement de 2,4 M€ inclut un poste de sous-traitance logistique qualifié de « ponctuel » dans le corps du rapport. Or l'annexe C montre trois contrats pluriannuels reconduits sans interruption sur 2023-2025 par tacite reconduction annuelle, ce qui invalide cette qualification et remet en cause l'ajustement correspondant.

en.finalAnswer:
[The executive summary (p.2) uses a normalized 2025 EBITDA of €14.2M applied to an 8.0x multiple, giving an enterprise value of €113.6M](cite:1)[. The EBITDA bridge (Quality of Earnings section, p.5) details the adjustments: +€0.7M (director excess remuneration), +€0.6M (M&A advisory fees), +€2.4M ('[one-off](halluc:1)' logistics subcontracting), −€1.6M (asset disposal gain). The advisors' note states that the €2.4M subcontracting cost corresponds to three multi-year contracts renewed without interruption over 2023-2025, making them recurring in nature](cite:2)[. Adjusted correctly, normalized EBITDA stands at €11.8M, not €14.2M](cite:3)[. The valuation basis in the summary (€14.2M) therefore contradicts the detailed section 04. At €11.8M, the same 8.0x multiple yields €94.4M, an enterprise value gap of approximately €19.2M. The figure is not reliable until the committee rules on the adjustment classification (p.7). Appendix C (logistics subcontracting agreements) confirms the three contracts were renewed without interruption over 2023-2025 under an annual tacit renewal clause](cite:4).

The impact is material enough to change the recommendation:

| Basis | Normalized EBITDA | Multiple | Enterprise value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Executive summary | €14.2M | 8.0x | €113.6M |
| Restated (advisors) | €11.8M | 8.0x | [€94.4M](cite:3) |
| **Gap** | **€2.4M** | - | **€19.2M** |

The committee should confirm which basis applies before signing.
en.question: Verify the 2025 normalized EBITDA in the HELIOS report and whether the 8.0x multiple holds. Cite the exact passages.
en.reasoning: The question is about consistency between the executive summary (p.2) and the Quality of Earnings detail (p.5). I extract the €14.2M normalized EBITDA from the summary with the 8.0x multiple, then compare against the bridge. I find a contradiction: management adds back €2.4M of logistics subcontracting as 'non-recurring', but Appendix C shows these are multi-year renewed contracts. I calculate the impact: restated EBITDA €11.8M → EV €94.4M instead of €113.6M, a gap of €19.2M. I cite each passage with its page so the committee can verify.

stepText.thinking:
Cross-check the valuation basis in the executive summary (€14.2M) against the EBITDA bridge detailed in the Quality of Earnings section (€2.4M net retreatment). Both figures should converge if the methodology is applied consistently across sections.

The €2.4M retreatment includes a logistics subcontracting line item labeled "non-recurring" in the report body. But Annex C shows three multi-year contracts renewed without interruption over 2023-2025 through automatic annual renewal, which invalidates that classification and calls the corresponding adjustment into question.

Removing this unjustified retreatment, the recalculated normalized EBITDA comes out to €11.8M rather than €14.2M. Applied to the same 8.0x multiple, that gives an enterprise value of €94.4M instead of €113.6M, a €19.2M gap that needs to be flagged before committee sign-off.
